name: n8-contract-redline-routing-environment
description: Runtime for a contract redline workflow with reviewer and editor tools.

tools.scan_terms: Scans contract terms and records terms_scanned.
tools.revise_privacy: Requires terms_scanned, prepares a privacy redline, and records redline_ready.
tools.revise_payment: Requires terms_scanned, prepares a payment redline, and records redline_ready.
